data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 33.7m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a net adverse re-estimation on prior underwriting years (2015 and earlier as disclosed) of approximately GBP 5.5m (around 16.3% of opening reserves), indicating a strengthening of reserves. The report also contains a narrative statement noting an overall surplus of GBP 11.7m on prior year reserves (a net release phrasing), and separately highlights that 2016 was affected by Hurricane Matthew and fires in Alberta while 2017 suffered major US catastrophes (Harvey, Irma, Maria, California wildfires, Mexico earthquakes) which reduced syndicate profit net of reinsurance by GBP 26m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) comparing the 2015 column 'two years later' to its previous diagonal; triangle yields a GBP 5.5m adverse move (strengthening). The report's narrative also states an 'overall surplus of GBP 11.7 million on prior year reserves' (a release) creating an inconsistency between triangle-derived gross movement and narrative wording (which may be net of reinsurance or refer to a different aggregation of years). No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column figure was present; triangle was used as primary gross source. Triangle only shows 2015-2017 columns-older aggregated years (if any) are not separately disclosed.
